about_the_game:
Star Squadron is a next-generation space combat simulator delivering unmatched immersion. Seamlessly transition from your carrier to space and back with no cutaways or loading screens. Our proprietary Voice Mimic System personalizes dialogue to your choices, your actions and your name with stunningly realistic performances. Coupled with a highly interactive narrative, every journey through Star Squadron will feel uniquely yours.

Voice Mimic System

The Voice Mimic System is a proprietary process we developed to combine an actor’s actual performance with the flexibility of voice synthesis. 

This allows deep personalization in voiced dialogue while maintaining all the nuances of a human performance:

  • Characters address you by whatever name you type in.

  • Personal details can be incorporated into dialogue like your hometown or your favorite band.

  • Mission debriefings reflect the actual events of your missions.

Seamless Transitions

Onboard your carrier, you can chat with fellow pilots and attend your mission briefing. Then you rocket into space, fly your mission, and return home. All of this is presented as a seamless continuous experience with no load screens, transitions, or cutaways.

Interactive Narrative

Coupled with the dynamism that our Voice Mimic System allows, Star Squadron features a highly dynamic narrative shaped by the player's actions. Any mission can be won or lost, often with multiple outcomes. Do you disobey orders to rescue an ejected wingman? Do you succeed or only make things worse? It is your actions that will determine the outcome. What will your story be?
